pr_metadata.title: feat(backend): enable sub-conversation creation using a different agent
pr_metadata.description:
## Summary of PR

<!-- Summarize what the PR does, explaining any non-trivial design decisions. -->

**Context:**

According to the [Planning Agent documentation](https://www.notion.so/Planning-Agent-2a9ed25a91688098801debaac50d7b3f?source=copy_link), when a user switches to the Planning Agent from the UI, a sub-conversation must be created from the current conversation. This sub-conversation will:
- Inherit the same workspace as the parent conversation.
- Be used specifically for generating and managing the PLAN.md file.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- The API successfully creates a new sub-conversation when invoked.
- The sub-conversation retains the same workspace as the parent conversation.

Example request payload.

```js
{
    "parent_conversation_id": "cd0a309c-9576-452d-a536-9d102fcbbc90",
    "agent_type": "plan"
}
```

We can refer to the video below for the output of the PR.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ebfa6104-e6dd-435e-9c28-2dc63256f3ab
